title: An Act relative to the water and sewer commission of the town of Hopedale

abstracts.abstract: By Representative Murray of Milford and Senator Fattman, a joint petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 5611) of Brian W. Murray (by vote of the town) that the water and sewer commission of the town of Hopedale be authorized to be the appointing authority for all employees of the water and sewer department.  Municipalities and Regional Government.  [Local Approval Received.]
